scope: Fresh source-only peer review of the bounded guest SEO assertion diagnostics. No browser, heavy test, UI interaction, implementation edit, child agent, or push.

runtime_verdict.reason: This review inspected source only. No runtime result or prior failed comparison receipt was available in the inspected stabilization run records, so native behavior remains unverified.

diagnostic_review.evidence: assertNext accepts only fixed predicate call sites (links, images, readability, performance, doors), stores scalar actual/expected values only when boolean or finite number, and substitutes predicate_evaluation_failed for other failures. The current wrapped assertions use fixed, source-authored assertion labels; value-bearing strict/deep comparison failures are multiline and therefore replaced by the fallback. The failure object does not store arbitrary DOM values, URLs, transport errors, or credentials.
diagnostic_review.limit: Assertion labels are accepted from error.message based on length and newline checks, rather than selected from a fixed allowlist. Current call sites use static assertion messages and are bounded, but a future assertion with a short single-line message derived from page content could bypass that assumption.

public_fixture_counts.evidence: next_detail_public_counts contains only public-DOM link/image integer counts, bodyHasText boolean, and alternate/schema type counts. It omits the page title, text, URL, hrefs, and schema labels.

acceptance_integrity.evidence: The existing links and images assertions were split into separately wrapped functions without removing their comparisons. Readability, performance, and schema/hreflang-door assertions remain invoked through assertNext. Each passing target is emitted only after its corresponding assertion succeeds; optional door activation still requires unique candidates and otherwise remains unverified. No added browser action or mutation is introduced by this commit.

remaining_limits: No runtime execution was performed; failure-stage behavior and the written receipt are not attested live.
The short-message assertion-label guard is safe for the current static assertion call sites but should be made an explicit allowlist if future wrapped assertions include dynamic messages.

next_action: Owner may proceed with guarded runtime review after preserving the prior comparison receipt; this report does not establish runtime acceptance.
